**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The document contains only one MFN-type provision, § 7.6 (p0031), and it runs in our favour — Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Northwind will be no less favourable than fees offered to similarly situated customers. No reciprocal or Customer-side best-terms obligation exists anywhere (Fees, Scope, and General reviewed; document-wide searches for best pricing, "no less favourable", third-party matching, parity, and right-to-match returned nothing further). Accordingly, no redline was proposed; the Vendor-granted MFN should be retained as drafted.
